# pvr

> pvr is the command-line tool for Pantavisor device state: check out a device's state as JSON, change it, commit, sign, and push it to a device or Pantahub. Written in Go, Apache-2.0.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/pantavisor/pvr/blob/main-draft/README.md): what pvr is, install, quick start, command overview
- [Command index and global flags](https://github.com/pantavisor/pvr/blob/main-draft/docs/index.md)
- [Product documentation](https://docs.pantavisor.io)
